scripts.move: mv vocabulary.html dist/index.html && mv vocabulary.context.jsonld vocabulary.jsonld vocabulary.ttl dist/
scripts.release: bash -c 'VERSION=$0; npm run build && cp dist/vocabulary.context.jsonld "dist/contexts/$VERSION.jsonld" && git add -f "dist/contexts/$VERSION.jsonld" && echo "Release context staged at dist/contexts/$VERSION.jsonld; review and commit it to finish the release."'
